title: SKYX Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call and Corporate Update to Be Held Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time
body_markdown:
Company to Provide Corporate Update and Discuss Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


MIAMI, Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SKYX Platforms Corp. (NASDAQ: SKYX) (d/b/a SKYX Technologies) (the "Company" or "SKYX"), an award-winning, highly disruptive advanced smart home and AI platform technology company with over 120 U.S. and global pending and issued patents and a portfolio of 60 lighting and home décor websites, with a mission to make homes and buildings advanced, safe and smart as the new standard, today announced that it will host its third quarter 2026 earnings conference call on **Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time** .


Management will provide a corporate update and discuss the Company's third quarter 2026 financial results and recent business developments.


**Participating Management**


SKYX participating management members will include:


- Rani Kohen, Founder and Executive Chairman
- Lenny Sokolow, CEO
- Steve Schmidt, SKYX President
- Derek Richardson, CEO of Deako, SKYX's Home and Builder Division
- Marc Boisseau, CFO

**About SKYX Platforms Corp.**


SKYX Platforms Corp. (NASDAQ: SKYX) is an advanced smart home, artificial intelligence (AI), and plug-and-play technology platform company with a mission to make homes and buildings safe, advanced, and smart as the new standard. Following its merger with Deako, Inc., SKYX combines complementary technologies designed to simplify the installation, integration, and upgrading of smart home and building systems across residential, commercial, builder, and hospitality markets.


The combined company offers a broad portfolio of plug-and-play platform technologies and products spanning ceiling and wall electrical infrastructure, intelligent lighting and switches, smart home and AI-enabled solutions, and other connected home and building applications. By bringing together SKYX's ceiling-based technologies and Deako's established wall-switch platform, the company enables a more comprehensive approach to smart homes and buildings, reducing the complexity associated with traditional wired installations while enhancing convenience, safety, and functionality.


SKYX has a combined portfolio of more than 120 issued and pending U.S. and international patents and patent applications relating to smart home and building platforms, AI, and plug-and-play technologies. Including its wholly owned subsidiary, Deako, SKYX supplies plug-and-play smart lighting technologies to more than 60 U.S. homebuilders and builders. The merger expands SKYX's opportunities across the homebuilder, professional, commercial, and hospitality markets, while creating potential for future recurring revenue through product upgrades and interchangeability, AI-enabled services, monitoring, subscriptions, and licensing.


In addition to its technology platforms, SKYX owns a portfolio of 60 lighting and home décor websites serving retail and commercial customers. Through its combined technologies and product portfolio, SKYX is focused on advancing the adoption of smart, connected, and safer environments in homes and buildings across the United States and internationally.
